newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-MEMC raised to short-term buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-MEMC raised to short-term buy.

text.p: -- Southcoast Capital Corp said Thursday it was raising its short-term rating on MEMC Electronic Materials Inc to buy from hold, after the silicon wafer manufacturer reported a first quarter loss of $0.07 a share, an improvment from the fourth quarter loss of $0.14 a share.
-- The company also reported revenues rose 10 percent from the fourth quarter to $222.3 million, while gross margins were 12.6 percent in the quarter, up from 6.7 percent in the fourth quarter.
-- The long-term rating for the company remains buy, analyst Ashok Kumar said in a research note.
-- While the data are still much worse than first quarter 1996 results, Kumar said MEMC appears to have passed the bottom in terms of sequential quarterly results.

-- "We believe that the company has reached the trough in run rate, and while we are not increasing our 1997 earnings estimate of $0.90 (a share), we are revising our ratings ... with a price target of $30," Kumar wrote.
-- MEMC was up 2-3/4 at 25-7/8 Thursday, and was the second biggest percentage gainer on the New York Stock Exchange.
